detail.descriptionHtml:
Research Area:

Metabolics

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C225H348N48O68
  • Molecular Weight: 4813.53 g/mol
  • Sequence: H-His-Ser-Asp-Gly-Thr-Phe-Thr-Ser-Asp-Tyr-Ser-Lys-γ-Glu-[2×AEEA]-Lys-Lys-Lys-Thr-Lys-Thr-Cys-OH
    (This sequence reflects modifications and conjugation for prolonged half-life and experimental receptor binding studies.)
  • Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

This synthetic peptide analog is provided for research use only and is designed to support laboratory investigation of modified peptide structures in controlled experimental systems. The compound is utilized in non-clinical environments to examine structure–property relationships, peptide stability characteristics, and receptor binding interaction characteristics in defined assay systems. This material has not been evaluated for clinical, therapeutic, or diagnostic use.

Product Designation Note:

This product is identified using an internal designation for cataloging and differentiation purposes. It is not marketed, labeled, or represented as any approved pharmaceutical or therapeutic compound.

Research Applications:

In controlled laboratory research settings, this peptide analog is utilized to support investigation of:

  • Receptor binding interaction modeling involving modified peptide analogs
  • Structural analysis of long-chain peptide constructs
  • Comparative evaluation of synthetic conjugation and linker strategies
  • Screening assay development and analytical evaluation in controlled experimental systems

All research activities are conducted in non-human, non-clinical experimental models.

Storage and Handling:
  • Store the lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic handling practices to ensure product quality and sterility.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

This compound is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
